newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Adamjee Insurance up 7.65 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Adamjee Insurance up 7.65 pct.

text.p: Adamjee Insurance, Pakistan's largest insurance company, jumped 7.25 rupees, or 7.65 percent, to 102 on Tuesday on tax breaks, dealers said.
A turnover of 9,000 shares of the blue-chip company was recorded at the Karachi bourse in early trade.
"The withdrawal of capital gains tax from insurance companies will have a positive impact," dealer Manochar Jamal of Taurus Securities said.

Under a government relief package for stock markets unveiled on Monday, insurance companies will be exempted from capital gains tax on stocks traded on the stock exchange and income from trading shares will be exempted from the tax on turnover.
